hero.title: Genuine. Guaranteed. Delivered.
hero.subhead: iPhone, Samsung, Android and computers — a written warranty, delivery to all 58 wilayas, and you pay when it arrives.
hero.trust: Over 4 years serving customers across Batna and eastern Algeria.

categories.title: What are you looking for?
categories.subhead: Five categories, all in stock at the shop and all under warranty.

featured.title: Titanium, and a camera that shoots cinema.
featured.subhead: The iPhone 16 Pro, with the A18 Pro chip and a three-lens system. One device that does everything, from filming to gaming.

range.title: The full range
range.subhead: Phones and computers picked one by one, every unit genuine and sealed.

bestsellers.title: Best sellers
bestsellers.subhead: What our customers are buying most this month.

accessoriesSection.title: Accessories that hold up
accessoriesSection.subhead: Chargers, earbuds, cases and protection — chosen and tested before they reach the shelf.

warranty.title: A written warranty
warranty.body: You leave the shop with a warranty slip in your hand, not a promise. It states what is covered, and for how many months.

genuine.title: Genuine, factory-sealed devices
genuine.body: Every device arrives factory sealed. You can check the IMEI in front of us before you pay a dinar.

delivery.title: Delivery to all 58 wilayas
delivery.body: We ship anywhere in Algeria — carrier desk or your door, your choice. And you pay when it arrives.

aftersales.title: We don’t vanish after the sale
aftersales.body: Something wrong? Come back to the shop and we handle it: repair, exchange, or a hand with the software.

services.title: In-store services
services.subhead: We don’t only sell. We repair, we unlock, and we fix the things that go wrong.

delivery.title: We deliver wherever you are
delivery.subhead: 58 wilayas, cash on delivery, and your order confirmed in under 24 hours.
delivery.note: The prices shown are the standard grid. Deep-south wilayas cost a little more depending on the carrier — we tell you at confirmation, before you pay anything.
